import json
p='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/BOEING_2018_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(p) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
texts=data.get('texts',[])
for i,t in enumerate(texts[:80]):
    txt=t.get('text','')
    if 'registrant' in txt.lower() or 'boeing' in txt.lower():
        print('IDX',i,'PAGE',t.get('page_no'),'TEXT',txt[:300].replace('\\n',' '))
PY"
